childReport.manualNotes: The requested paper appears to be a hallucinated citation. Two plausible confusions are documented in the file for the parent: (a) TabDPT, arXiv 2410.18164 (2024), which self-describes as the first scaling-law analysis for tabular foundation models with exponents alpha=0.42/beta=0.39; and (b) Hog et al., 'Towards Reliable Scaling Laws for Tabular Foundation Models' (FSML 2026 workshop, https://ml.informatik.uni-freiburg.de/publications/), whose title is a near-match but whose authors and year differ. Neither is the requested paper, and I did not promote either as an answer.
